purpose.zh: 练习空心体姿势的建立、短停和控制回落，保持躯干张力
purpose.en: Practise entering a hollow-body position, holding briefly and lowering with trunk control.

text.zh: 下背保持舒适承托，肩胛和双腿一起抬起
text.en: Keep your lower back comfortably supported as you raise your shoulder blades and both legs

text.zh: 双臂向头顶伸长，双腿并拢，先建立腹部控制
text.en: Reach the arms overhead, bring the legs together and establish trunk control first.

text.zh: 抬起时继续呼吸，手臂与腿只放到腰背能控制的位置
text.en: Keep breathing as you lift, using only an arm and leg position you can control through the lower back.

text.zh: 短暂停留后缓慢回落，不甩腿或憋气
text.en: Pause briefly and lower slowly without swinging the legs or holding the breath.

commonErrors.zh: 为了手脚放低而拱腰，或用摆动启动
commonErrors.en: Arching the lower back to lower the limbs or using momentum to begin.

commonErrors.zh: 颈部紧绷、肩耸起或全程憋气
commonErrors.en: Straining the neck, shrugging the shoulders or holding the breath throughout.

items.zh: 腰背：维持能控制的承托，不以腰部疼痛换取更长杠杆。
items.en: Lower back: maintain a controlled supported position without using a longer lever through pain.

items.zh: 颈肩与呼吸：头颈跟随上躯干，保持自然呼吸，不用力耸肩。
items.en: Neck, shoulders and breathing: let the head follow the upper trunk, breathe naturally and avoid forceful shrugging.

items.zh: 本动作引发疼痛时停止，不通过增加幅度或负重继续；先向医生或物理治疗师确认。
items.en: Stop if this exercise causes pain; do not add range or load before seeking clinical advice.

items.zh: 已有医嘱限制仰卧卷躯干、双腿抬起或腹部用力时，先取得许可。
items.en: Obtain clearance first if supine trunk curling, double-leg raising or abdominal loading has been restricted.

definition.countingSemantics: The8-second source contains two entry/brief-hold/release demonstrations, each with only1.8 seconds at the high hollow position. Preserve the timed prescription of3 sets x20 seconds and the legacy range. Looping this source is not a continuous20-second hollow hold; sustained-hold playback or a timed dynamic interpretation needs editorial confirmation and must not be inferred from the clip.
editorialNotes: 保留源的腰/骨盆约束、上下肢弧线bow补偿与两次短停，不为凑20秒擅改动画。名称为空心体支撑这一动作族，具体起落示范与持续hold处方差异必须编辑审定。
旧“手腿越低越难”属于教学负荷推断；本稿改为腰背可控制范围，不把低越好作为要求。
w-dead-bug来自旧明确替代，减少双直腿长杠杆的降阶候选；不依旧level1断定固定难度顺序。独立同模式进阶未核定。
本稿保留旧目录剂量数字和范围。rhythm描述真实8秒示范，不把短演示循环当作已完成持续时间处方；需要专业编辑确认播放/计数。
主要/协同肌群含姿势稳定或次要拉伸角色，未作肌电定量结论；动作关系是现有ID候选，不能自动消费旧模型媒体。
通用禁用筛查依据catalog/v2/definition-evidence.md及AAOS髋/脊柱康复资料；具体到各动作的应用是待审编辑推断，没有疾病特异绝对禁忌或临床适用性批准。
